# abpred

run
```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5,echo=FALSE}
# Setup before loop
set.seed(123)
n <- 30
a <- 10
b <- 10
c <- 10
d <- 10
e <- 0.5
ws<- -1
w <- 1

#for(model in c("sigmoid","linear")){
#for(model in c("tanh")){
for(model in c("sigmoid","p2","relu","linear")){
#for(model in c("exp")){
#for(model in c("sigmoid")){
#for(model in c("linear")){

print(model)
base_fol <- "out/TSS/ite_abpred/rf/"
dir.create(base_fol, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
# Assuming folder creation is required only once
cv<-c()
cvv<-c()
# Loop over 100 iterations
for (iteration in 1:10) {
 print(iteration)
  fol <- paste0(base_fol, "TSS_",model,"_nabcd_iter", iteration, "_", n, a, b, c, d, e)
  
  # Ensure directories for each iteration
  dir.create(fol, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
  dir.create(paste0(fol, "/pdf"), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

  data <- simdata6(n=n, a=a, b=b, c=c, d=d, ws=ws, w=w, model=model,noise=e)
  
    
  A <- data$A
  B <- data$B
  C <- data$C
  D <- data$D
  
  # Prediction and saving results
  RFlist <- list(A=list(A=A))
  Y <- B
  res <- getRF(RFlist, Y)
  
  
  saveRDS(res, paste0(fol, "/resb_a"))
  

  Bpred <- matrix(NA, nrow = nrow(Y), ncol = ncol(Y))
  for (i in 1:ncol(Y)) {
    Bpred[,i] <- res$y.pred.list[[i]][,"A"]
  }
  saveRDS(Bpred, paste0(fol, "/Bpred_A"))
  
  Bpred<- readRDS(paste0(fol,"/","Bpred_A"))

  #AB  <- list(A=A,B=B)
  ABpred <- list(A=A, Bpred=Bpred)
  RFlist <- list(ABpred=ABpred)
  
  Y <- C

  res <- getRF(RFlist,Y)

  saveRDS(res,paste0(fol,"/","res_abpred"))

  res2 <- getRFab(RFlist,Y,dummy="Bpred",Tv=B)
  #res2 <- getRFab(RFlist,Y)
  
  
  saveRDS(res2,paste0(fol,"/","res_abpred_b"))
  
  res12_all<- rbind(data.frame(res2$resultEachModel),data.frame(res$resultEachModel))
  
  rownames(res12_all)<-c("ABpred_AB","ABpred")
  
  cor10<-t(res12_all)
  cvv<-rbind(cvv,cor10)
  corm<-rowMeans(res12_all)
  cv<-rbind(cv,corm)
}

saveRDS(cvv,paste0(base_fol,"/",model,"cor10"))
saveRDS(cv,paste0(base_fol,"/",model,"corm"))

cvv<-readRDS(paste0(base_fol,"/",model,"cor10"))
cv <-readRDS(paste0(base_fol,"/",model,"corm"))

max_cv <- 1
min_cv <- -1

 
}


```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=8}
n <- 30
a <- 10
b <- 10
c <- 10
d <- 10
e<- 0.5

ws<- -1
w <- 1
# 2×2のレイアウトを設定
par(mfrow = c(2, 2),pty="s")

for (model in c("linear", "relu", "p2", "sigmoid")) {
base_fol <- "out/TSS/ite_abpred/rf/"
dir.create(base_fol, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
# Assuming folder creation is required only once
cv<-c()
cvv<-c()
# Loop over 100 iterations

cvv<-readRDS(paste0(base_fol,"/",model,"cor10", n, a, b, c, d, e))[1:100,]
cv <-readRDS(paste0(base_fol,"/",model,"corm", n, a, b, c, d, e))
 

# max_cv <- max(cv, na.rm = TRUE)
# min_cv <- min(cv, na.rm = TRUE)


if(model=="p2"){
 model="square"
}
max_cv <- 1
min_cv <- -1
cvv_original<-cvv

cvv<- subset(cvv, cvv[,1] >= 0 | cvv[,2] >= 0)
removed_cvv <- cvv_original[!(cvv_original[,1] >= 0 | cvv_original[,2] >= 0), ]
print(model)
print(table((cv[,1]-cv[,2]) < 0))
print(table((cvv[,1]-cvv[,2]) < 0))
# Create the plot using the max and min for x and y limits
plot(cvv, xlim = c(min_cvv, max_cvv), ylim = c(min_cvv, max_cvv), 
     main = paste0("C prediction (RF-RF): ",model),ylab="Trained by A + Bpred", xlab="Trained by A + B",
     cex=1
     #, xlab = "A", ylab = "ABpred"
     )
points(removed_cvv, col = "black", pch = 1)

# Add the 45-degree line
abline(0, 1, col = "red")

t_test_result <- wilcox.test(cvv[,1], cvv[,2], paired = TRUE)
print(t_test_result$p.value)
saveRDS(cvv_original,paste0(base_fol,model,"cvv.RDS"))
}

# レイアウトを元に戻す
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```
